exposure: double balloon catheter with extra-amniotic saline infusion (EASI)
single balloon catheter with extra-amniotic saline infusion (EASI)
outcome: Time from device insertion to delivery
cohort: Women at term with a singleton pregnancy presenting for labor induction
finding: The double balloon catheter with EASI resulted in reduced time to delivery and higher vaginal delivery rates compared to the single balloon catheter with EASI, without compromising maternal or fetal safety.
